items.exampleEn: I am tired, so I will go to bed early.
items.exampleZh: 我很累，所以早點上床睡覺。

items.exampleEn: My friends are very nice. I often play with them.
items.exampleZh: 我的朋友人都很好，我常常和他們一起玩。

items.audioEn: It is late, so Emma gets up and goes home.
items.audioZh: 時間晚了，所以 Emma 起身回家。

items.sentenceEn: There are some apples on the table.

items.stemEn: It is cold today, ____ I am wearing a coat.
items.stemZh: 今天很冷，所以我穿外套。

items.stemEn: My grandparents live near the sea. I love ____ very much.
items.stemZh: 我的祖父母住在海邊附近，我非常愛他們。

items.passageEn: Emma has a small garden. There are some flowers in it. When she gets up in the morning, she gives them water. Which flower does she like? She likes the red one. It is very big, so everyone can see it.
items.passageZh: Emma 有一個小花園，裡面有一些花。她早上起床時會幫它們澆水。她喜歡哪一朵花呢？她喜歡那朵紅色的。它很大，所以大家都看得到。

questions.questionZh: Emma 什麼時候幫花澆水？

referenceEn: When do you go to school?
What time do you go to school?
rubricZh: 「什麼時候」可寫，例如 when、what time 等
疑問句用 do 放在主詞前面

referenceEn: There are some flowers on the table.
Some flowers are on the table.
rubricZh: 用 some 表示「一些」，可數名詞用複數（例如 some flowers）
可寫，例如 There are some flowers…、Some flowers are… 等
